title: FluentShell renderer protocol v1 payload
description: JSON payload carried after the fixed 32-byte little-endian FLSH frame header.
$comment: Same-major minor revisions may add JSON fields. Consumers ignore unknown fields while continuing to enforce known required fields and resource caps.

richText.$comment: Minor 35: a read-only rich edit control as paragraphs of runs, each run one character format. Sizes and indents are points; color is 0xRRGGBB or -1 for the control's automatic colour.

performanceGraph.$comment: Minor 36: Performance Monitor's graph as read from the System Monitor control. series[].values holds one entry per graph slot in drawing order (null where the counter had no sample); barSlot is the slot of the newest sample of a wrapping chart (-1 for a scrolling one). Times are milliseconds since the Unix epoch and colours are 0xRRGGBB.

performanceLegend.$comment: Minor 36: the legend under the graph. Each row's cells follow the Show and Color columns, one per remaining column.

performanceValueBar.$comment: Minor 36: the value strip under the graph (Last, Average, Minimum, Maximum, Duration), labelled by the control's own strings.

nativeDocument.$comment: Runtime validates unique DOM keys, scroll containment and exact range extents, action tokens, report ownership, 256 aggregate report rows, 65536 text characters and 1 MiB owned premultiplied images. Native HWND descendants are absorbed only after the complete DOM/COM contract accounts for them.

ownerDrawCombo.$comment: One face pair per canonical label. Fixed mode has uniform heights; selected and normal dimensions match. All faces together are bounded to 1 MiB decoded BGRA. Native style, lengths, and pixel premultiplication are also checked by both runtime adapters.

toolbarStateImage.$comment: Dimensions must equal the toolbar item's normal image. Normal and state images together retain the 64 * 96 * 96 * 4 decoded-byte toolbar budget.

nativeListGroupId.description: Signed 32-bit native group ID in canonical decimal spelling; range and sentinels are validated by both codecs.

nativeListItemId.description: Canonical uint32 identity including zero and excluding the UINT_MAX failure sentinel.

allOf.$comment: Minor 33: a large virtual report ListView carries a window of its rows. items and rows hold the rows from itemWindowStart on; itemCount is the list's length, and every index (selection, focus, actions) stays absolute.
Minor 32: a scrolling container carries its standard scroll bars and the viewport (clientRect) its scrolled children are clipped to. clientRect otherwise belongs only to an MDI child.
A container pane is admitted geometrically: its children tile it and every strip that divides it is a real splitter.
An accessible island's elements own no HWND, so they travel as typed items on the island's own node rather than as virtual nodes.

itemDefaultActivation.description: A ListView or TreeView item may be opened (double-click, Enter) by the openItem action: the item is selected and its control is sent the Enter key.

itemNativeIds.description: Canonical LVM_MAPINDEXTOID identities. Empty means no stable identity contract. Runtime validation requires one per item when activation is supported.

imageList.description: Compact referenced icons. Runtime validation also limits aggregate decoded BGRA pixels to 1048576 bytes per node.

stateImageList.description: Referenced TreeView state-image icons, sharing the normal image list's count and decoded-pixel budget.

items.$comment: Only an image item carries pixels: what the host painted for a graphic its provider describes.

directUiNode.$comment: Only capability-derived DirectUI semantics remain. Virtual provider text, separators, bounded host-painted images, and property-sheet buttons have no HWND; every other admitted role is HWND-backed.

else.$comment: A translated task dialog presents its main instruction, command links (with their note as helpText), elevation shields and expando button through presentationVariant; no other generic node carries adapter fields.

allOf.$comment: A translated MessageBox or TaskDialog is answered by the Bridge itself, so no native dialog HWND tree exists and every node on it is virtual.

popupMenu.$comment: The protocol validator resolves nodeId and itemIndex to an accessibleIsland dropdown, a diskView item, or (minor 32) the TreeView or ListView item whose contextMenu request opened it. The opener may be disabled while the native popup is tracking. Menu paths and command IDs are scoped independently from window.menu.

allOf.$comment: Minor 32: scroll a scrolling container through the application's own line/page handling, toward a position or by signed line steps.

contextMenu asks for an item's own menu. Minor 34's openItem selects the item and sends its control Enter (a double-click), where the node offers itemDefaultActivation; both witness the item by label.
Minor 33: move a windowed virtual ListView's window by scrolling the native list so the row is its top row.
